verdict.rationale: Docs confirm fine-grained personal access tokens exist with a defined permissions model (per-endpoint scopes, X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions header), showing GitHub supports creating and scoping PATs for API auth. However, evidence lacks details on the actual token creation UI/flow, expiration/rotation management, or revocation, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documentation of the PAT creation/management UI workflow, token rotation/expiration settings, and revocation process, plus community validation of the experience.
